findings.title: Owner can front-run claim() to redirect entire payment via nudgeSplit (slippage does not cover split distribution)
findings.description: setNudgeAddress() and setNudgeSplit() are unguarded onlyOwner setters with no timelock and no per-claim authorization. A malicious or MEV-aware owner can observe a pending claim() in the mempool and atomically set nudgeSplit=100 with an owner-controlled nudge address before inclusion. The slippage parameter minRewardTokenSupplied only checks actualPayment >= min (the total paid by the claimer), NOT the split distribution between phlimbo and nudge. Result: claimer pays full amount, NFT burned, strategies drained, but 100% of payment routes to the owner instead of Phlimbo. This is both a per-claim revenue grab (econ-04 mempool-race framing) and a systemic theft vector since slippage cannot defend the share split (code-01 framing).
findings.preconditions: Owner is malicious, compromised, or accidentally misconfigures; mempool visibility of pending claim() useful but not strictly required.
findings.suggested_fix: Add per-claim minPhlimboAmount (or expectedPhlimboShare) slippage parameter; cap nudgeSplit (e.g., to 30); impose 1-block timelock on nudge changes.

findings.title: claim() denormalization can compute actualPayment==0 while still draining strategies, allowing free claims of small yield
findings.description: After totalNormalizedYield>0 check, claimerPayment = totalNormalizedYield * (10000 - discountRate) / 10000, then actualPayment = _denormalizeAmount(claimerPayment, rewardToken). With low-decimal reward token (USDC=6) and tiny 18-dec yield, actualPayment can floor to 0. Strategies are still drained to claimer; no actualPayment==0 guard. Free yield extraction up to NFT supply.
findings.preconditions: rewardToken decimals < 18 AND strategy yield small enough to truncate.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert if actualPayment==0 before withdrawing from strategies.

findings.title: NFT burn before yield availability check (gas griefing only)
findings.description: NFT burn occurs at start of claim(); reverts roll back the burn so this is mostly cosmetic. Wastes claimer gas on bad-state claims; minor griefing edge cases.
findings.suggested_fix: Move NFT validate/burn after totalNormalizedYield computed.

findings.title: Cross-contract reentrancy via nudge address with hookable rewardToken
findings.description: nudge is an arbitrary owner-set address receiving reward tokens BEFORE phlimbo.collectReward. nonReentrant blocks claim() re-entry but not cross-contract callbacks if rewardToken has hooks (ERC777, ERC1363). With standard USDC: low risk. setRewardToken does not enforce hookless tokens.
findings.preconditions: rewardToken has transfer hooks AND nudge is attacker-controlled.
findings.suggested_fix: Reorder: phlimbo.collectReward first, then nudge transfer (CEI). Or guard rewardToken type.

findings.title: No validation that nudge != phlimbo, address(this), minterAddress
findings.description: setNudgeAddress accepts any address. Aliasing to phlimbo, address(this), or minter causes silent misallocation. address(this) is particularly bad — no rescue function exists.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert if _nudge in {address(this), phlimbo, minterAddress, nftMinter, rewardToken}. Add rescueToken function.

findings.title: approvePhlimbo allows owner to revoke phlimbo allowance, DoSing claims
findings.description: If phlimbo.collectReward pulls via transferFrom, owner setting approval to 0 DoSes claim flow. Tx reverts so no fund loss; pure liveness.
findings.suggested_fix: Push to phlimbo via safeTransfer instead of relying on pull approval.

findings.title: setRewardToken emits no event; missing two-step pattern across config setters
findings.description: setRewardToken emits no event (asymmetric vs other setters). Old reward token's allowance to phlimbo not zeroed during rotation.
findings.suggested_fix: Emit RewardTokenUpdated; clear old allowance on rotation.

findings.title: Slippage protection only one-sided; calculateClaimAmount inconsistent with claim() under owner-state changes
findings.description: Owner can pause tokens or change exchange rates between calculateClaimAmount() and claim(), causing actualPayment to swing. Only minRewardTokenSupplied (lower bound) is protected; no upper bound. The view function matches claim() at fixed state but state is fluid (pause, exchange rate, discount). Compounds the higher-severity slippage gap (econ-01 family).
findings.suggested_fix: Add max-payment slippage parameter. See DEDUP-09 for the higher-severity claimer overpayment angle.

findings.title: NFT burn assumes NFTMinter honors burn semantics
findings.description: _validateAndBurnNFT trusts NFTMinter to actually decrement balance. Bug or malicious minter could let user re-claim without burn.
findings.suggested_fix: Compare balanceOf before/after burn, or require NFTMinter enforces invariant.

findings.title: No event for nudge/phlimbo split amounts
findings.description: RewardsClaimed reports total but not nudgeAmount/phlimboAmount. Off-chain attribution requires trace inspection.
findings.suggested_fix: Emit NudgePayment and PhlimboPayment events.

findings.title: Independent setters for nudge/nudgeSplit allow inconsistent state DoS; nudgeSplit==100 bypasses phlimbo.collectReward hook
findings.description: setNudgeSplit(50) while nudge==address(0) DoSes claim() until owner fixes. setNudgeAddress(0) when nudgeSplit>0 also breaks the invariant. Additionally, when nudgeSplit==100, phlimboAmount=0 so collectReward(0) is never called and Phlimbo accounting hooks may be bypassed.
findings.suggested_fix: Atomic setNudgeConfig(addr, split); setters revert on inconsistency; consider always calling collectReward(0).

findings.title: Unconfigured token decimals/exchangeRate fall back silently (KNOWN ISSUE — flagged for sanitizer)
findings.description: Documented known issue (#8 in project's known issues: 'Token config with zero decimals/exchange rate defaults to 18 decimals and 1:1 rate'). Preserved here per dedup instructions but expected to be removed by the sanitizer stage.
findings.suggested_fix: Already known.

findings.title: Single misbehaving strategy reverts entire claim() (liveness loss across all strategies)
findings.description: No try/catch around strategy.withdrawFrom. Any failing strategy DoSes the whole claim across all strategies until owner removes/pauses the offending one. Full liveness loss for legitimate claimers while the failing strategy persists.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap withdrawFrom in try/catch; emit StrategyFailed; continue with remaining strategies.

findings.title: Fee-on-transfer behavior in strategy withdrawals miscounts received yield
findings.description: User billed for `yield` but receives `yield - fee`. Fee-on-transfer rewardToken is documented OOS; strategy-level fees on the asset withdrawn from strategies are not.
findings.suggested_fix: Use balance-delta accounting for received yield.

findings.title: setPhlimbo does not zero old phlimbo's allowance on rewardToken
findings.description: Old phlimbo retains rewardToken approval after rotation. Bounded by trusted phlimbo and transient SYA balance, but expands trust surface unnecessarily.
findings.suggested_fix: Zero old phlimbo's allowance in setPhlimbo before approving the new one.

findings.title: setDiscountRate allows 100% discount, enabling free strategy drain
findings.description: rate==10000 allowed; produces actualPayment==0; combined with absent zero-payment guard (DEDUP-02 / code-03), any NFT holder drains strategies for free.
findings.suggested_fix: Require rate < 10000; guard actualPayment > 0.

findings.title: Admin setters not gated by whenNotPaused — config drift during pause
findings.description: Owner can mutate config while paused. Next claim post-unpause uses new config without warning. Amplifies front-running risk (see DEDUP-01).
findings.suggested_fix: Gate config setters with whenNotPaused or add settling delay.

findings.title: Slippage parameter does not protect claimer against adverse discount-rate / exchange-rate changes (claimer overpays)
findings.description: minRewardTokenSupplied checks actualPayment >= min (lower bound) — but the bot's risk is OVERPAYING, not underpaying. If owner reduces discount rate or raises exchange rate between simulation and inclusion, claimer pays MORE than expected for the same yield. Slippage check passes (actualPayment > min); claimer is forced into an unprofitable trade.
findings.attack_path: Bot quotes 14.7 USDC for 15 USD yield at 2% discount, sets min=14.7. Owner sets discount=0; actualPayment becomes 15. Check passes; claimer pays full price for 0 profit.
findings.suggested_fix: Add maxRewardTokenPaid (upper bound) AND/OR minNormalizedYieldReceived; or rename current parameter.

findings.title: Yield withdrawn to claimer BEFORE payment collected (CEI violation)
findings.description: strategy.withdrawFrom transfers yield to msg.sender (line 480) before safeTransferFrom payment (line 504). FOT rewardToken would brick the claim. Callback-token strategies allow intra-tx external manipulation.
findings.suggested_fix: Move payment collection BEFORE strategy withdrawal loop (CEI).

findings.title: Nudge mechanism allows owner to redirect 100% of claim revenue with no cap
findings.description: setNudgeAddress accepts any address; setNudgeSplit accepts up to 100. Owner can synchronously redirect all claim revenue to an EOA. No cap, no timelock, no beneficiary lock. Expands trust model beyond documented assumptions. Distinct from DEDUP-01 (front-running) — this is the standing systemic-redirect vector.
findings.attack_path: Owner key compromise → setNudgeAddress(attacker); setNudgeSplit(100) → all future claim revenue diverted permanently.
findings.suggested_fix: Cap nudgeSplit (e.g., 20-30%); require nudge has code; add timelock; pauser-callable emergency reset.

findings.title: Nudge as 'soft pause' bypasses dual-unpause governance
findings.description: Behodler3's dual-unpause design intends bilateral unpause to prevent owner-only reward denial. Setting nudgeSplit=100 to a burn address achieves permanent rewards denial unilaterally. Pauser has no nudge authority, so the governance invariant is undermined.
findings.suggested_fix: Pauser-callable emergencyZeroNudge; or cap nudgeSplit < 50%.

findings.title: Compound precision loss in normalize/denormalize round-trip
findings.description: Per-strategy normalization, then aggregate denormalization, rounds DOWN systematically — claimer-favored. Dust per-call.
findings.suggested_fix: Document; or per-strategy denormalize and reconcile.

findings.title: Strategy removal strands accumulated yield
findings.description: removeYieldStrategy doesn't require zero pending yield. Phlimbo loses that yield permanently. Re-addition produces a windfall to the first claimer.
findings.suggested_fix: Require zero pending yield (or force-claim) before removal.

findings.title: Strategy yield computation trusts external balance reads (flash-loan donation)
findings.description: yield = totalBalance - principal. If a strategy's balance is inflatable via flash-loan donation, an attacker drains real reserves at discount. SYA-layer makes no defensive bound. Strategies themselves are OOS, but SYA's defensive gap is in-scope.
findings.suggested_fix: Per-claim yield cap; or TWAP yield.

findings.title: Token-pause yield backlog captured by single MEV claimer on unpause
findings.description: MEV bot back-runs unpauseToken to capture the entire pause-window yield at standard discount.
findings.suggested_fix: Delayed unpause, or metered backlog release.

findings.title: setRewardToken mid-life leaves stale tokenConfig assumptions
findings.description: Owner switching reward token changes the denormalization base. Front-running a pending claim with setRewardToken DoSes the claim or shifts payment unit. Distinct from DEDUP-07 which is event/allowance hygiene.
findings.suggested_fix: Require new token has tokenConfig; two-step migration; expectedRewardToken parameter in claim().
